shared_elements: standing human figure in elaborate costume
large plumed headdress above the head
arms held out/bent with ornamented wrist cuffs
apron or loincloth panel hanging below the waist
feather or drapery panels flanking the body
vertical single-figure composition filling a tall field
curvilinear mask-like/scroll motifs in the lower zone
justification: Both depict a single richly costumed standing personage occupying a tall vertical field, with a tall plumed headdress crowning the head, banded ornaments at chest and wrists, an apron falling between the legs and broad feather/cloth panels flanking the body \u2014 a fairly specific costume scheme rather than a generic human figure. The main difference is that B adds a lower register of large curvilinear mask/scroll motifs beneath the figure and shows the head more frontally, whereas A concentrates entirely on the figure with a profile head and no separate register.
